title: A tensor counit square specialized to a coefficient in degree zero
statement: Let C and D be Grothendieck abelian braided closed monoidal categories with functorial flat resolutions and chosen derived categories. Let F:C -> D be additive and monoidal and preserve the coproducts indexed by each fiber of addition on integers. Let L:D(C) -> D(D), a derived tensor comparison delta, and geometric representatives g(P):L(QP) -> Q(FP) satisfy the cochain tensor counit square and naturality. Given k:F(M) ~= N, a single-coefficient comparison s:L(M[0]) ~= N[0] whose hom is g(single M) followed by Q of the ordinary single comparison and k, and t:tensorRight(M);F ~= F;tensorRight(N) whose hom is the ordinary oplax comparison followed by k, the canonical tensor-single comparisons q satisfy delta;(id tensor s);(g(P) tensor id);q(FP,N) = L(q(P,M));g(P tensor M);Q(t_P) for every cochain complex P. TensorSingleCounitSquare is exactly this equation, packaged as a regular predicate.

proof.text: Use the coefficient hypothesis to replace s by g(single M) followed by Q of the ordinary single-complex comparison and k. Lax monoidal naturality of Q moves the latter morphism through its tensorator. Apply the given cochain tensor counit square to P and single M. This is the abstract tensorCounitSingleDiagram calculation.

The proved source-library mapBifunctorComparison_δNatTrans_single₂ and mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso_inv_naturality₂ identify the ordinary cochain tensor comparison followed by the single-complex comparison and k with the degreewise natural tensor comparison t. Convert mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans to the cochain oplax map generically using mapCochainComplex_δ; transport t using complex_square_hom. Naturality of g, functoriality of Q and associativity finish the equation. All these calculations are proved in the module.

theorem tensor_single_cochain_counit
    {C : Type w} {D : Type w'} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{v'} D]
    [Abelian C] [Abelian D]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v} C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{v'} D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalPreadditive D]
    [MonoidalClosed C] [MonoidalClosed D] [BraidedCategory C] [BraidedCategory D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} C] [HasDerivedCategory.{v'} D]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [F.Monoidal] [∀ j, PreservesColimitsOfShape
      (Discrete (ComplexShape.π (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) (.up ℤ) ⁻¹' {j})) F]
    (L : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory D)
    (δ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj L).obj (curriedTensor (DerivedCategory C)) ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ (DerivedCategory D)).obj L).obj L).obj
        (curriedTensor (DerivedCategory D)))
    (g : ∀ P : CochainComplex C ℤ, L.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
    {M : C} {N : D} (k : F.obj M ≅ N)
    (s : L.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N)
    (t : tensorRight M ⋙ F ≅ F ⋙ tensorRight N)
    (hs : s.hom = g ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj M) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex F (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app M ≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).map k.hom))
    (ht : Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δRightNatTrans F M ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft F ((curriedTensor D).flip.map k.hom) = t.hom)
    (hd : LaxSquareHδ (Q₁ := DerivedCategory.Q) (Q₂ := DerivedCategory.Q)
      (F := F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) δ g)
    (hn : ∀ {P R : CochainComplex C ℤ} (a : P ⟶ R),
      L.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map a) ≫ g R =
        g P ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a))
    (P : CochainComplex C ℤ) : TensorSingleCounitSquare F L δ g M N s t P
